errors.empty: Write something, or add a picture.

errors.pinDuration: Choose how long the pin lasts.

voice.failed: That recording did not work. Try again.
voice.scrub: Drag to move through the message

voice.loadFailed: Could not load. Tap play to try again.
voice.speed: Playback speed {{rate}}. Tap to change it.

reply.hidden: A message from someone you blocked
reply.notLoaded: That message can no longer be shown here.

chat.holdHint: Hold for reactions, reply and more
chat.photoReady: Photo ready — add a caption if you like

receipts.nobody: Nobody else is in the building yet.
receipts.unavailable: Could not load who has it. Try again in a moment.

chat.toLatestNew: {{n}} new messages. Go to the latest.

pin.title: Choose how long your pin lasts
pin.body: Everyone in the building sees it at the top of the room. You can unpin it at any time.
pin.replaces: Three messages are pinned already: this one takes the place of the oldest.

errors.notFound: This complex was not found, or you are no longer in its office.
errors.tooMany: A complex cannot have that many buildings.
errors.nameInvalid: Give each building a name of at least two letters.

errors.buildingElsewhere: That building already belongs to another complex.
errors.needsManager: This building has no manager of its own. Invite one for it first — without the office it would have none.
errors.lastManager: The office needs at least one manager. Make someone else a manager first.
errors.memberNotFound: This person is no longer in the office.
errors.memberExists: This person already has that role in the office.
errors.fromOffice: This role comes from the complex office. Change it on the office's Staff page.

office.title: Complex office
office.notInOffice: Only the complex's managers and accountants see its office page.
office.subtitle: {{role}} · {{n}} buildings
office.firstBody: Your complex is approved. Add all its buildings in one go — names, floors and flats — then invite your staff.
office.openHint: Tap a building to open it: bills, payments and flats work the same as in any building.

add.title: Add buildings
add.intro: Answer three questions and every building is prepared for you. You can change any name or code before they are created.
add.word: Word before the letter or number
add.flatsHint: Leave "Flats per floor" empty to add the flats later, building by building.
add.template: Copy charges and billing day from
add.templateHint: The new buildings start with the same monthly charges and the same billing day.
add.summary: {{n}} buildings · {{flats}} flats each · {{total}} flats in all
add.codeHint: A building's code starts every bill and receipt number of it, and must be unique.

staff.title: Office staff
staff.intro: Everyone here works in every building of the complex: managers and accountants in all of them, a guard in all of them or only at the gates you choose.
staff.offline: Changes to the office need the internet.
staff.revokeBody: Nobody will be able to join with it.
staff.codeBody: Give this code to your new {{role}}. They enter it in Manzel to join the office of {{complex}}.

roleHelp.manager: Runs every building: flats, bills, payments, notices and people. Can change the office.
roleHelp.accountant: Bills and payments in every building. Cannot change the office.
roleHelp.guard: Checks visitor codes at the gate, for all buildings or the ones you choose.

staff.removeBody: The role in every building of {{complex}} ends.

settings.title: Complex settings
settings.managersOnly: Only the complex's managers can change its settings.
settings.defaultsHint: New buildings start with this billing day and days to pay, unless they copy another building.
settings.charges: The same charges in every building
settings.chargesHint: Set up the monthly charges in one building, then copy them to all the others. A charge a building already has is not added twice.
settings.letGoBody: The office stops running it, and its roles there end. The building keeps its flats, bills, residents and its own manager.
settings.letGoDone: {{name}} is no longer part of the complex.
settings.bringIn: Buildings you manage on their own
settings.bringInHint: Add a building you already manage to this complex, so the office runs it too.
settings.broughtIn: {{name}} is now part of the complex.

register.buildingHelp: A single building with its own manager.
register.complexHelp: Several buildings run by one office. Its managers, accountant and guards work in every building.
register.intro: Tell us about the complex. We check every request before it goes live — usually with a phone call. After approval you add all its buildings in one go.
register.name: Complex name
register.codeHint: {{min}}–{{max}} English letters or digits. Its buildings get their codes from it, e.g. {{example}}.
register.unitCount: Number of flats in all buildings
register.approvedBody: Open the office to add the complex's buildings and invite your staff.

notice.manyHint: Each of the {{n}} buildings gets its own copy, published at once.
notice.oneHint: Only this building's residents will see it.
notice.partly: It reached {{n}} buildings, then stopped. Send it again to the rest.

people.fromOfficeBody: This role comes from the complex office. It is changed or removed on the office's Staff page.

admin.explain: Approving creates the complex; the requester becomes its office manager and adds the buildings.
admin.approveBody: {{person}} becomes the manager of the complex's office and adds its buildings.
admin.similarTitle: Complexes with a similar name or the same code

notices.title: Notices
notices.emptyBody: Notices you send to one building or to all of them appear here, together.

qr.title: Building QR code
qr.entryBody: For the entrance: people scan it to ask to join
qr.intro: Print this or put it in the entrance. Whoever scans it fills in who they are, and you approve or reject it — scanning alone gives nobody anything.
qr.poster: Scan with Manzel to ask to join this building
qr.shareFailed: The poster could not be shared.
qr.rotateBody: Every printed poster stops working at once. Print the new one.
qr.safetyTitle: A scan is a request, not a key
qr.safetyBody: Nobody joins until you approve them, and you see their name, flat and number first. If a poster leaves the building, make a new code.

scan.title: Scan a building QR
scan.entryBody: Ask to join a building yourself
scan.aim: Point the camera at the QR in the entrance.
scan.notOurs: That is not a Manzel building code.
scan.cameraTitle: The camera is needed to read the code
scan.cameraBody: It is used only for this. No photo is taken or kept.
scan.useCode: I have an invite code instead

request.title: Ask to join
request.roleHint: The manager sees this and decides.
request.phoneHint: The manager rings this number to check who you are.
request.approvalNote: A manager of the building approves or rejects this. You will be told either way.
request.sentBody: The managers of {{building}} have been told. You will hear when they decide.
request.scanAgainBody: The poster may have been replaced. Ask the manager for the current one.
request.signInFirstBody: A request to join is sent by a person, so sign in with your phone number first. After that, this building's request opens by itself.

mine.title: My requests
mine.entryBody: Buildings you have asked to join
mine.emptyBody: Scan a building’s QR to ask to join it.

review.title: Requests to join
review.entryBody: People asking to join this building
review.emptyBody: When somebody scans the building’s QR and asks to join, they appear here.
review.approveBody: They become {{role}} · {{flat}}. You can change or end this later in People.
review.rejectBody: They are told, with your reason.
review.reasonHint: The person reads this, so say what was wrong.

errors.qrInvalid: That code is not current. Ask the manager for the poster in the entrance.
errors.alreadyMember: You are already in this building.
errors.alreadyOpen: You have already asked to join this building.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.phoneRequired: Give a number the manager can ring.
errors.reasonRequired: Say why, so the person knows.
errors.notFound: That request is no longer waiting.

units.title: Flats
units.emptyBody: Add the flats first, then invite the residents.

billing.title: Billing
billing.generatedNone: Every flat already has an invoice for this month. To change them, use Fix this month.
billing.publishHint: Residents do not see an invoice until you publish it.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyBody: When your manager issues this month's bill, it appears here.

payments.title: Payments
payments.recordedOffline: Payment recorded. It will be sent when you are back online.
payments.referenceHint: Bank slip number or SMS code
payments.reverseBody: Receipt {{receipt}} is reversed and the invoice reopens. This stays in the audit trail.

tickets.title: Repairs
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. No water in the bathroom
tickets.descriptionPlaceholder: When did it start? Where in the flat?
tickets.createdOffline: Request recorded. It will be sent when you are back online.
tickets.emptyBody: If something is broken, record it so the manager knows.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.entryBody: Building meetings — in person, by voice or by video
meetings.emptyManager: Plan one with the + button — in the lobby, or by voice or video call.
meetings.emptyResident: When the management plans a meeting, it appears here and everyone is told.
meetings.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Generator repairs and the new fee
meetings.agendaPlaceholder: What will be discussed, one point per line

modeBody.audio: A group voice call in the app, up to 8 people.
modeBody.video: A group video call in the app, up to 4 people.

meetings.created: Planned. Everyone in the building has been told.
meetings.movedNote: Changing the time, place or kind of meeting tells everyone again.
meetings.cancelBody: Everyone in the building is told, with your reason.
meetings.cancelReasonPlaceholder: e.g. The manager is travelling this week
meetings.cancelledToast: Called off. Everyone has been told.

rsvp.title: Will you come?
rsvp.saved: Thank you — the manager can see your answer.

meetings.opensAt: The call opens 15 minutes before the start.

errors.forbidden: Only the building's managers can plan meetings.
errors.titleRequired: Give the meeting a title of at least 3 letters.
errors.timeInvalid: Pick a time at least 5 minutes from now and within a year.
errors.rateLimited: That is a lot of meetings for one day.
errors.notFound: That meeting is no longer there.
errors.notOpen: The call opens 15 minutes before the start.
errors.inPerson: This meeting is in person — there is no call to join.
errors.reasonRequired: Say why, in at least 3 letters.

multiBuilding.joinAnotherBody: Enter an invite code. It joins this account — no second sign-in.
multiBuilding.haveAccountBody: Sign in with your phone first, then enter this code. Every building you belong to stays in one account, and you switch between them without signing out.
multiBuilding.contactPhoneHint: Your manager uses it to reach you. To sign in with it on another phone, verify it later in Settings.
multiBuilding.signInToJoinBody: We will send you a code. After signing in, your invite code is waiting on the next screen.
multiBuilding.verifyPhoneBody: We will send a code to it. Once verified, it signs you in to this account on any phone, with all your buildings.
multiBuilding.verifyPhoneRow: Sign in with it on any phone, with all your buildings

suspended.title: Your account is closed
suspended.body: Manzel’s operators have stopped this account from being used.
suspended.noContacts: Manzel has not published a support contact yet. Please try again shortly.

buildingClosed.title: {{building}} is closed
buildingClosed.feeBody: The building's monthly Manzel fee has not been paid, so the building is closed until the platform receives it.
buildingClosed.manualBody: A Manzel operator has closed this building. Nobody can work in it until the platform opens it again.
buildingClosed.feeReason: The monthly platform fee was not paid by its due date.

inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyBody: Messages from the people who run Manzel appear here.
inbox.pushOff: Notifications are switched off for Manzel
inbox.pushOffBody: You will still see them here, but not while the app is closed.

push.title: Push on this phone
push.on: On — you are told when the app is closed.
push.off: Off. Turn it on in the system settings.
push.ask: Not set up yet. Tap to allow.
push.unavailable: Not available in this version of the app. Notifications still arrive here.

notices.showUntilHint: Residents stop seeing it after this day. Leave it empty to keep it up until you end it.
notices.showUntilPast: Choose today or a later day.
notices.offline: Notices are published and changed online, so everyone sees the same thing.

empty.live: No notice is showing right now.

notices.emptyLiveBody: Publish one with the + button. Residents see it within seconds.

done.end: Residents no longer see this notice.

confirmEnd.title: Stop showing this notice?
confirmEnd.body: It disappears from residents' phones now. You can show it again later.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this notice?
confirmDelete.body: It is removed from every resident's phone. This cannot be undone.

batch.oneHint: Only the copy in {{building}} changes, and it stops following the other buildings.
batch.pickHint: Choose the building this is for.
batch.confirmOne: This applies only to {{building}}; the other buildings keep the notice as it is.

leave.title: Leave this building
leave.body: You will stop seeing {{building}} — its notices, bills and payments — on every phone you use. Your past payments stay on the building's record. To come back you need a new invite code.
leave.exportBody: Save a PDF of every bill and payment of flat {{unit}} up to today, as your record. After you leave you cannot open them here.
leave.confirmBody: You can only come back with a new invite code from the manager.
leave.notExported: You have not saved your records yet.
leave.lastManagerHint: Invite another manager and let them accept before you leave, so someone can still run the building.
leave.offline: Leaving a building needs the internet.
leave.removeBody: They stop seeing this building on their phone. Their past payments stay on the flat's record.
leave.unitEmpty: Flat {{unit}} has no residents now. If nobody lives there, mark it vacant with Edit so it is not billed.

errors.lastManager: You are the building's only manager.

recovery.haveCode: I have a sign-in code from my manager
recovery.noSmsBody: Ask your building's manager for a one-time sign-in code. It opens your own account, with all your buildings.
recovery.signInBody: Your building's manager can make you a one-time code. Type it here to get back into your own account — nothing new is created.
recovery.invalidCode: That code does not work. It may be mistyped, already used, or older than 15 minutes — ask for a new one.
recovery.noCodeHint: No code? The manager makes one in Manzel: People → your name → Help them sign in.
recovery.helpBody: Make a one-time code {{name}} types on their phone to get back into their own account, with all their buildings. It works once, for 15 minutes.
recovery.onlyThem: Give it only to {{name}}, in person or on a phone call. Whoever has the code can open the account.
recovery.giveBody: Read this to {{name}}. They open Manzel and choose “I have a sign-in code from my manager”.
recovery.whereToType: Making another code cancels this one.
recovery.shareMessage:
Your Manzel sign-in code: {{code}}
Open Manzel and choose “I have a sign-in code from my manager”. It works once, until {{time}}.
recovery.operatorHint: A one-time code that opens this account on another phone — for someone who cannot receive a text message or email.

errors.forbidden: You can make sign-in codes only for residents, guards and accountants of your building. A manager's code comes from the building's owner or from Manzel.
errors.self: You cannot make a sign-in code for yourself.
errors.notFound: That account is no longer there.
errors.rateLimited: That is a lot of codes. Try again in an hour.

profile.title: Your name
profile.welcomeBody: Your building manager and neighbours see it on invoices, receipts and notices.
profile.nameHint: First and last name, as people know you.
profile.phoneLocked: This is the number you sign in with. It cannot be changed here.
profile.addContact: Add a phone number or email
profile.phoneSignsIn: You sign in with this number.
profile.changePhoneSoon: A new sign-in number has to be confirmed with a text-message code. That is coming soon.
profile.contactPhoneHint: Your manager calls you on this number. It is not used to sign in.
profile.phoneOffline: Connect to the internet to save a new number.
profile.verifyPhone: Verify it to sign in with it

errors.phoneVerified: This number signs you in. Change it by verifying a new number.

accountDelete.title: Delete account
accountDelete.entry: Removes your account and what it holds, for good
accountDelete.lead: Deleting your account removes it for good. Nobody can bring it back, and to use Manzel again you would join a building again.

goes.identity: Your name, phone number and email, and your sign-in.
goes.places: Your place in every building and office.
goes.chat: What you wrote and sent in building chats.
goes.support: Your conversations with Manzel’s support, and your ideas.
goes.devices: Your phones’ notifications, your call history and the people you blocked.

stays.records: Payments you recorded, notices you posted, repairs you reported and visitor passes you made stay in the building’s records, because its accounts need them.
stays.flat: Your flat’s bills and receipts belong to the building and stay with the flat.

accountDelete.understand: I understand this cannot be undone
accountDelete.confirmBody: This happens now and cannot be undone.
accountDelete.offline: Connect to the internet to delete your account.

errors.operator: A platform operator cannot delete their account here. Another operator must remove you from the operators first.
errors.lastOfficeManager: You are the only manager of a complex’s office. Make someone else a manager there first.
errors.lastManager: You are the only manager of one of your buildings. Make someone else a manager there first.

residents.title: Residents
residents.inviteBody: Give this code to the resident. They sign in with it.
residents.moreFlats: {{n}} more — type a flat number above to find it.

sync.offlineBody: Keep working. Everything is sent when you are back online.
sync.staleBody: Connect to the internet to refresh it.
